headline: On October 9, 1984: Thomas & Friends Premieres on ITV
captionCards: Based on books by Rev. Wilbert Awdry
instagramCaption:
The Island of Sodor came to life in 1984.

Britt Allcroft developed the British series based on The Railway Series by Reverend Wilbert Awdry and Christopher Awdry. It premiered on ITV, centering on Thomas the Tank Engine and anthropomorphic steam locomotives.

This adaptation brought the fictional island's vehicles to a global audience, establishing a lasting cultural legacy for children's television.
